registration_rule: Lock this file and source manifest before collecting pilot outcomes; publish changes as a new protocol version with reasons.
population: Consenting health-professions learners practicing on synthetic authored cases; no patient records.
design: Feasibility run: independent faculty review of authored probes. Later efficacy study: randomized parallel assignment to system feedback or standard practice, baseline and held-out follow-up cases, blinded faculty outcome raters; one learner is the analysis unit.

outcomes.primary_future: Between-arm difference in each learner's mean change per common scored faculty-reviewed rubric domain on a held-out follow-up case; exclude N/A domains instead of imputing a score. No learning result from authored fixtures.
secondary_future: Safety-critical action recall on held-out learner transcripts
Fact-level disclosure precision/recall on fully faculty-reviewed turns
Semantic reply supported/unsupported agreement with independent faculty labels
Per-domain quadratic weighted Cohen kappa of independent faculty scores
Difficulty discovery effect with faculty-approved full presets and sampled learners
outcomes.analysis: Intention-to-treat by assigned learner, report missing outcomes by arm; compare arm mean change with a two-sided 95% confidence interval. Cluster repeated visits within learner. No interim significance testing or post hoc target changes.

sample_size_rationale.grader_feasibility: The PRD mentions 15–20 double-rated transcripts; target 20 as a feasibility floor, with broad confidence intervals and no power claim.
sample_size_rationale.release_precision: About 100 independent fact-level judgments would yield a worst-case normal-approximation 95% margin near 0.10 at p=0.5; correlated facts and turns reduce effective information, so report clustered intervals when data permit.
sample_size_rationale.efficacy_planning: For a future parallel-arm comparison with standardized effect 0.5, two-sided alpha 0.05 and 80% power, normal approximation gives about 63 learners per arm; allowing 15% loss suggests about 74 per arm. This is a planning assumption, not a justified clinical effect or current recruitment target.

privacy.cases: Synthetic authored cases only; never import real patient data.
privacy.learner_consent: Obtain documented opt-in and institutional ethics/IRB determination before collecting learner audio, transcript, or scores; refusal must not affect grading.
privacy.minimization: Pseudonymous learner IDs, no names, email, audio or free-text identifiers in this repository; redact incidental personal information before annotation.
privacy.storage: Keep consent linkage, raw recordings and reviewer identities in institution-controlled private storage under an approved retention/deletion schedule. Only aggregate metrics and source-locked synthetic fixtures may be committed.
privacy.access: Blinded reviewers receive case context and transcript but not model predictions, level labels, actual releases, provisional rubric grades or group assignment. Confirm organizational independence outside metadata checks.
